name: manual_24a5a9
claim: Email addresses in ALLOWED_GMAIL_COAUTHORS are NEVER checked for non-gmail domains. The gmail_allowed() gate in check_commit_message.sh only runs when the email ends in @gmail.com or @googlemail.com. Any personal domain (e.g. a custom vanity domain) stored in ALLOWED_GMAIL_COAUTHORS will silently fall through to DENIED. Fix: put non-gmail personal/org addresses in ALLOWED_EXACT_COAUTHOR_EMAILS instead.

decisions.notes: Generalized the illustrative domain example, no real private domain remains.

rationale: Generalized the illustrative domain example, no real private domain remains.
